description: The user changed reading aloud in Settings: picked a voice, saved, replaced or removed the Inworld key on the website, or started or cancelled the download of the Kokoro voice on a Mac. Only the part changed, which `voice` saves and announces as voice.changed.

voice.description: The id of the voice picked, one of the voices `voice: read` lists.

key.description: The account's Inworld key; an empty string removes it. Never shown in the trace (7.2).

download.description: Start or cancel the download of the Kokoro voice on this Mac.
